services.name: Parties & Rentals
services.desc: The Snoqualmie Depot is open 7 days a week, 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM. The Railway History Campus is open Wednesdays through Mondays, 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Looking for a unique space to hold your next party, corporate event, or gathering? Check out what the Northwest Railway Museum has to offer. Birthday parties are offered at the Railway History Campus (RHC) and include a train ride, Train Shed Exhibit Hall admission, a private party space, engineer’s cap for the birthday child, and goodie bags for the kids.
